reuse.why: The daily-skip rule is written inline in getNextDate rather than in (or beside) the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend that schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts also use, so those paths keep moving daily weekend occurrences.

duplication.why: No copy-paste, but it adds a second, getNextDate-only definition of weekend handling next to the shared helper the other paths call.

placement.why: It is in shared/schedules.ts, but inside one consumer's body instead of the shared weekend-adjustment definition.

scope.why: Small and focused: one branch and one test.

maintainability.why: Daily schedules now skip weekends for the next date but still move them in upcoming-date lists and budget templates, and the next change to weekend rules must be made in several places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getNextDate special-cases daily schedules inline instead of extending getDateWithSkippedWeekend (or a shared occurrence filter), leaving server/schedules/app.ts:515 and server/budget/schedule-template.ts:175/192 on the old rule.

one_place.where: Only getNextDate applies the skip; getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and the schedule template's date adjustment in server/budget/schedule-template.ts still move weekend occurrences for daily schedules.
